purpose: Pre-acceptance path-and-symbol ownership baseline; no supported package interface is created.

sourceScope: src/lib production JavaScript and TypeScript tracked at the audit revision
discovery.runtimeIdBranchRule: AST comparisons, switch cases, membership branches, and null/empty legacy defaults containing a current runtime ID; grouped by exact path and containing symbol, with sourceLines enumerating branch-expression sites.
discovery.directOpenShellRule: Production call expressions outside src/lib/adapters/openshell/client.ts that invoke the established OpenShell wrappers or execute an OpenShell CLI/gateway process directly; grouped by exact path and containing symbol, with sourceLines enumerating the call sites.
exclusions: Files matching *.test.* or *.spec.*, paths under fixtures/ or __test-helpers__, and files marked test-helper, test-helpers, test-support, test-fixture, or test-fixtures.
Declarative JSON, YAML, lockfiles, generated output, and public documentation; package inventories and release checks own those surfaces.
OpenShell installer and release resolution commands because they do not invoke the OpenShell runtime API.
Ordinary SSH or SSHFS execution after a validated OpenShell ssh-config response; the ssh-config acquisition remains audited.
Generic local host commands such as swap setup and Homebrew retention checks because they do not invoke OpenShell.
commandEvidence: One-shot TypeScript AST audit of the rules above; no reusable scanner or syntax fingerprint was added in Phase 1.

supportedOpenShell.parityPolicy: Similarity is not parity. A facet converges only after repository-owned deterministic and exact live E2E evidence for the supported release.
